recommendations.title: Immediate PQC Assessment
recommendations.description: Conduct an immediate assessment of all quantum-vulnerable cryptographic systems, focusing on RSA and ECC implementations.

recommendations.title: Migration Roadmap
recommendations.description: Develop a comprehensive post-quantum cryptography (PQC) migration plan with defined milestones and resource allocation.

recommendations.title: Data Classification
recommendations.description: Classify sensitive data by longevity requirements to prioritize protection against Harvest Now, Decrypt Later attacks.

recommendations.title: Vendor Coordination
recommendations.description: Engage with technology vendors to understand their PQC roadmaps and ensure alignment with your migration timeline.

harvestNowDecryptLater.description: Your organization processes financial records with long-term sensitivity. Adversaries may be harvesting encrypted data now for future decryption.

cryptographicallyRelevantQuantumComputer.description: Current RSA and symmetric implementations will be vulnerable when CRQCs become available, estimated within 5-10 years.
